thread:
maria: Quick weekly check-in for AcmeCorp — seeing an uptick in errors this week across our generation/chat/embeddings endpoints. Focus: 5xx, timeouts, rate-limits. Need triage and a short customer update.

healthbot: ALERT: error-rate spike detected for acme-corp namespace — combined 5xx+timeouts > 3% threshold (auto-detected).

sam: Can you drop the exact numbers?

maria: Sure — week over week: 5xx 0.9% -> 2.7%; timeouts 0.4% -> 1.9%; rate_limit errors 0.2% -> 1.1%. Usage +18% (bulk-sync job). Spend steady but unit cost up due to retries.

jonathan: Quick debug notes: reproduced a failure pattern locally. Long-context + parallel fan-out causes KV cache thrash -> memory pressure -> 504/5xx. Saw OOM logs around Wed 11:20 UTC.

jonathan: sample log snippet:
```
ERROR: model-infer.cpp: kvcache alloc failed at seq 1024
Stack: infer_loop -> kv_update -> alloc
OOM: attempted 512MB, available 120MB
```

sam: Is the timing correlated with their new nightly bulk-sync?

lee: Yes — Acme turned on a nightly bulk-sync Tue night. It sends longer contexts and retries aggressively. They said parallelism was increased to speed up catch-up.

maria: Top failing endpoints (past 7d by 5xx count):
- POST /v1/generate — ~45% of 5xx
- POST /v1/chat/stream — ~22%
- POST /v1/embeddings — ~12%
- POST /v1/rerank — ~8%
- POST /v1/health/check — ~6%
- GET /v1/status — remaining
Timeout concentration: /v1/chat/stream and /v1/generate on long sequences (>512 tokens). Rate-limit spikes mostly on /v1/embeddings during bulk bursts.

jonathan: Repro recipe: 700-token requests with fan-out x4 -> KV cache misses -> latency spike -> 504. Short-term mitigations: limit per-request tokens, reduce parallelism, enable LRU cache tuning. Long-term: guard on excessive token length.

sam: Operational playbook items (proposed):
1) Apply temporary throttle on their bulk-sync user-agent (rate cap) -> reduces burst
2) Canary-rollback Wed deploy if evidence shows regression
3) Increase pod memory or KV cache size on their dedicated pool
4) Add a hard reject for >1024 tokens with 429 rather than letting runtime OOM

maria: Customer comms plan: send a short note acknowledging the spike, actions we're taking (throttle + asking them to reduce parallelism), ETA for fix. Lee — can you own the message?

lee: Yep. I'll draft and ping here before sending. Also asking them to pause parallel fan-out overnight.

jonathan: I'll create infra task to bump KV cache capacity and deploy an LRU tweak to their pool. Also adding a guard to reject oversized requests. ETA 24h for initial infra changes.

maria: Renewal risk: moving from low -> medium due to recent instability and increased spend. After mitigation we should schedule an AE touchpoint to reassure and offer engineering support credits. @lee please coordinate.

lee: Scheduling Fri 10am PT call with Acme and their engineering lead. Will include usage guidance to reduce cost and failure surface.

sam: Incident stub created: INC-2024-867. Tracker: https://tracker/internal/INC-2024-867

maria: Next steps checklist:
- jonathan: infra changes (kv + guard) — ETA 24h
- lee: customer comms + Fri call — ETA EOD tomorrow
- sam: temporary throttle rule on bulk-sync UA — ETA 2h
I'll post updates here. Thanks all :pray:

healthbot: NOTE: monitoring alert will auto-close if 5xx+timeouts < 1.5% for 30m.

maria: I'll update CSM dashboard and flag for renewal review.

sam: Updating on-call runbook with a link to this thread and the tracker ticket.

lee: Drafted customer note, sharing now for review in #private-drafts.

maria: Great — keep me posted and we can move AE outreach to prereq for renewal mitigation.

jonathan: I'll post link to infra PR when ready.

maria: Closing loop here once infra PR merged and customer call complete. Appreciate the quick responses.
